_note: Firmware kept as copies in more than one repository. Each copy must be the same as the others, file for file, except the files in 'differ' and its own .uf2. A .uf2, where there is one, must carry the source hash of the copy it sits in. 'uf2_required' is true once a release's .uf2 is tracked.
